# Di Dee Designers

> Di Dee Designers is a saree pre-pleating and box folding service in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India. It pleats and box-folds the customer's own saree in advance so it can be worn in minutes without arranging pleats by hand. Customers should share the saree fabric, style and occasion details so preparation suitability and handover arrangements can be confirmed before booking. Di Dee Designers prepares sarees; it does not sell them.

## Prices (per saree, INR)
- Box folding (pressed pleats): ₹250 - everyday and office sarees
- Semi-fluffy pleats: ₹300 - functions and festivals
- Full-fluffy pleats with hanger: ₹400 - full-volume pleat style
- Final price is confirmed on WhatsApp before booking.

## Services
- Saree pre-pleating and box folding
- Preparation suitability for different fabrics and saree details is confirmed individually before booking.
- Pleating to your style
- Service areas: Tiruppur, Avinashi and Erode. Contact us to confirm request availability and handover arrangements.
- Requests involving multiple sarees can be discussed; acceptance and any applicable price are confirmed before booking.
- Date-sensitive requests are reviewed individually; timing is confirmed before booking.

## How to book
1. Message +91 90030 37820 on WhatsApp with location, occasion date, saree type and quantity.
2. Get the price, preparation-suitability confirmation and agreed handover arrangements.
3. Follow the saree handover instructions confirmed before booking.
4. Use the collection or return arrangement confirmed for your order.

## Contact
- Business name: Di Dee Designers
- Business location: Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90030 37820
- Service areas: Tiruppur, Avinashi, Erode (Tamil Nadu, India)
